title: Keto Charred Tunisian Potatoes Skillet
description: A keto-friendly Tunisian dish featuring charred baby new potatoes in a stone-bowl-dolsot, perfect for a brunch mood, with a molten and savory flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, garlic, harissa, paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Heat a large stone-bowl-dolsot or skillet over medium-high heat and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until they are charred and tender.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the potatoes with crumbled feta cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
